Rogue Flight, take up positions. Wing leaders, form up on me.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back (radio)">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Rogue Leader''' was a title and call sign given to the commander of the elite [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Because of Rogue Squadron's fame, the person holding the title of Rogue Leader was often considered the best active pilot in the Defense Force. Since only one Rogue Leader was ever killed in action&mdash;[[Lensi]]&mdash;and he was shot down by a previous Rogue Leader&mdash;[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]&mdash;this is understandable. Various pilots have taken that position over the years.

While serving as Rogue Leader, Antilles switched to the call sign '''Rogue One''' during the [[Battle of the Poln system]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and the [[Battle of Gall]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The call sign '''Rogue Leader''' was temporarily assigned back to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for the duration of the latter battle.
